value.rationale: The equal-frequency finite-pair setting isolates pure orientational disorder, and the classification gives a complete natural stability phase interval rather than an arbitrary parameter point. It reveals the exact angular window width, a sharp existence threshold ω>√3, and an unexpectedly stronger perpendicular-axis threshold ω>4√2. This supplies a quantitatively motivated complement to qualitative and numerical misaligned-axis oscillator studies.
